Name: **Loc_ID**
Description: A unique identifier for this individual Single-Molecule (SM) Localization event.

Name: **Spot_ID**
Description: A unique identifier for the bright DNA or RNA Spot with which this individual SM Localization event is associated.

Name: **X**
Description: The sub-pixel X coordinate of this SM Localization event.

Name: **Y**
Description: The sub-pixel Y coordinate of this SM Localization event.

Name: **Z**
Description: The sub-pixel Z coordinate of this SM Localization event.

Name: **Channel**
Description: The wavelength characteristics of the emission channel that was used to image this individual SM Localization event.

Name: **Fluor**
Description: The name of the Fluorophore whose Emission is utilized to detect this individual SM Localization event.
